prompt: Ocak 2026 müşteri ve ürün bazında satılan adet nedir?
reference_sql: SELECT C.DEFINITION_, I.NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN S.TRCODE IN (7,8) THEN S.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) AS adet FROM dbo.LG_411_01_STLINE S JOIN dbo.LG_411_01_INVOICE F ON S.INVOICEREF=F.LOGICALREF JOIN dbo.LG_411_ITEMS I ON S.STOCKREF=I.LOGICALREF JOIN dbo.LG_411_CLCARD C ON F.CLIENTREF=C.LOGICALREF WHERE S.CANCELLED=0 AND S.LINETYPE=0 AND S.TRCODE IN (2,3,7,8) AND S.DATE_ >= '2026-01-01' AND S.DATE_ < '2026-02-01' GROUP BY C.DEFINITION_, I.NAME

sql:
SELECT TOP 50
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cl."DEFINITION_", ''), '(boş)') AS musteri,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(it."NAME", ''), '(boş)') AS urun,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
LEFT JOIN dbo_LG_411_CLCARD cl ON cl."LOGICALREF" = sl."CLIENTREF"
LEFT JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-01-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cl."DEFINITION_", ''), '(boş)'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(it."NAME", ''), '(boş)')
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC

sql:
SELECT 
    cl."CODE" AS musteri_kodu,
    cl."DEFINITION_" AS musteri_unvan,
    it."CODE" AS urun_kodu,
    it."NAME" AS urun_adi,
    SUM(sl."AMOUNT") AS satilan_adet
FROM dbo_LG_411_01_STLINE sl
JOIN dbo_LG_411_ITEMS it ON it."LOGICALREF" = sl."STOCKREF"
JOIN dbo_LG_411_CLCARD cl ON cl."LOGICALREF" = sl."CLIENTREF"
WHERE sl."CANCELLED" = 0
  AND sl."LINETYPE" = 0
  AND sl."TRCODE" IN (7, 8)
  AND sl."DATE_" >= '2026-02-01'
  AND sl."DATE_" < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 
    cl."CODE",
    cl."DEFINITION_",
    it."CODE",
    it."NAME"
ORDER BY 
    satilan_adet DESC
